items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Sometime they'd hire Faith Marable. He had his band up there.

ctx.x: Yeah, very awesome. 35, Rampart and Girard. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.

Then we had, uh, Dandy Lewis on bass. You heard of him. Yeah, I've heard Bess talk about him. That's right. Dandy Lewis. That's who we had on bass. Then after Buddy Johnson left, we taken Earl Umphrey on trombone. He played up there with us. Then... Manny Mineta come up there with us a while. Yeah, he told us he did. Yeah, he come up. He played with us a while. We had a nice band. Five band. We used to have two bands. Celestine, our band, and they had the big carnival bars. They hired two bands. Sometime they'd…
Something like that? Or was it Lawson?

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: And he'd come after he'd get off and both bands would play against each other.

ctx.x: Did Fayte ever come off the boat much to play jazz?

Yeah, he'd come and play it on the roof guard against us a lot of times. He'd come and play it on the Pelican. And I was playing with P. Shawne, he'd come and play a fine band. And Wilna Pfeiffer was playing with him.
Steady, he'd be on the boat pretty steady all the time.
